gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.299: Close fighting: left click throws a four-hit string, and the fourth blow sends a foe flying. Hold jump as the fourth lands for an uppercut, or land it in mid-air to slam them down. Alt is a quick dash, and holding it carries you on into a long roll, out of a crowd or a blast. Hold F to block, and tap it just before a blow lands to stagger the attacker. With no fight about, left click digs as ever. Press ` (left of 1) to fight your old way, and again to come back.
